column1: # When legal forms opened and closed to new firms (curated 2026-11-10 from the company laws named).
# A firm's founding date is never before "from" nor after "until". Only forms that were new, not
# renamed, carry a "from": a form that older firms were converted into (Belgium's BV in 2019,
# Ireland's LTD in 2015) would wrongly make every such firm young. Forms abolished before 2026
# are dropped in elf_overrides.tsv. code: an ISO 20275 code, or empty with "match", a regular
# expression on the form's names (for forms listed once per US state or Canadian province).
